segments.name: Uniform & Facility Service Solutions
segments.description: Designs, manufactures, rents, cleans, delivers and sells uniforms, protective clothing and non-garment items to businesses in the U.S. and Canada.
segments.evidence: The Uniform & Facility Service Solutions reporting segment designs, manufactures, purchases, rents, cleans, delivers and sells uniforms and protective clothing and non-garment items in the U.S. and Canada.

segments.name: First Aid & Safety Solutions
segments.description: Sells first aid cabinet services, safety supplies, fire safety and training to end users and wholesalers.
segments.evidence: The First Aid & Safety Solutions reporting segment sells first aid cabinet services, non-prescription medicines, safety supplies, fire safety and provides certain safety training to both end users and wholesalers.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Operates the nuclear garment decontamination business, renting and servicing specialty garments for nuclear applications.
segments.evidence: This reporting segment consists of our nuclear garment decontamination business.

revenueModel.text: Businesses pay UniFirst under written service contracts of three to five years for rental, lease and direct purchase of uniforms and related items and services.
revenueModel.evidence: We primarily serve our customers pursuant to written service contracts that range in duration from three to five years.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, all financial information was recast to reflect the current three-segment structure of Uniform & Facility Service Solutions, First Aid & Safety Solutions and Other.
changes.evidence: All financial information presented in this Annual Report on Form 10-K has been recast to reflect this segment structure for all periods presented.
